title: Which data observability tool fits you?

questions.q: How many tables do you need to watch?
questions.hint: Vendors bill by table, asset or credit, so your count shapes the bill.

options.label: About 10 or fewer
options.why: you have under 10 important tables, which fits the free plans

options.label: A few dozen
options.why: you have outgrown a 10 table free plan

options.label: Hundreds, across many teams
options.why: you have hundreds of tables and many teams

questions.hint: dbt transforms warehouse data with SQL.

options.label: Yes, dbt is central for us
options.why: Elementary alerts reuse your dbt tests

options.label: No, or not really
options.why: you do not need a dbt based tool

questions.q: Where does the tool need to run?

options.label: A hosted service is fine
options.why: a hosted service is fine for you

options.label: Hosted, with a free trial first
options.why: you want to try it before buying

options.label: Inside our own network or on-premises
options.why: you need a private network or on-premises option (Soda lists private deployment under Enterprise)

questions.q: How do you want to deal with price?
questions.hint: Of the pages we read, only Soda shows a paid dollar price.

options.label: I want to pay nothing to start
options.why: you want a free plan or free open-source tool

options.label: I want a public price before any sales call
options.why: Soda lists $750 a month for Team (checked Oct 2026)

options.label: A demo and a quote are fine
options.why: you are fine asking for a quote

questions.q: What do you most want it to do?

options.label: Daily alerts when a table looks off
Monitors that start with almost no setup
options.why: Metaplane is built for quick machine learning monitors

options.label: Checks written as code
options.why: Soda checks are written in YAML

options.label: Link data checks to our AI work
options.why: Bigeye pitches itself as an enterprise AI trust platform

options.label: Check that my code change did not alter the data
options.why: Datafold compares data before and after a change

monte.name: Monte Carlo
monte.summary: A paid platform that monitors tables, traces problems through lineage and routes alerts.
monte.bestWhen: you watch many tables across a whole company and will go through a quote.
monte.watchOut: no dollar figure is shown, billing is by credits, and one reviewer called the credit logic hard to predict.

metaplane.name: Metaplane by Datadog
metaplane.summary: A hosted tool with quick machine learning monitors and a free plan.
metaplane.bestWhen: you are a small team starting out with a few key tables.
metaplane.watchOut: Free stops at 10 tables, the Pro rate per table is not shown, and it now sits inside Datadog.

sifflet.name: Sifflet
sifflet.summary: A platform that bundles observability, a catalog and lineage, with plans by assets monitored.
sifflet.bestWhen: you use Snowflake or Databricks and want a platform sorted by assets monitored.
sifflet.watchOut: no dollar amounts are published, and one reviewer reported some false positives and too many alerts.

acceldata.name: Acceldata
acceldata.summary: A platform for data quality and cloud data cost, with cloud, on-premises and hybrid deployment.
acceldata.bestWhen: you run hybrid or on-premises setups.
acceldata.watchOut: no price is published, and one reviewer said deployment was time consuming.

anomalo.name: Anomalo
anomalo.summary: A monitoring product that can run fully in your VPC or as SaaS.
anomalo.bestWhen: your data has to stay inside your own network.
anomalo.watchOut: no price, free plan or trial is shown, and supported platforms are not listed in text.

soda.name: Soda
soda.summary: A data quality platform with code-first checks and a hosted product that includes observability.
soda.bestWhen: you want a public price and checks written as code.
soda.watchOut: Soda Core alone has no observability features, it uses the Elastic License 2.0, and SSO and private deployment are in Enterprise.

elementary.name: Elementary
elementary.summary: An open-source tool and dbt package that adds monitoring and alerts to a dbt project.
elementary.bestWhen: you already use dbt and want a free tool.
elementary.watchOut: the free tool needs dbt and covers one project, and Cloud prices are not published.

datafold.name: Datafold
datafold.summary: A platform known for Data Diff, which compares two versions of a dataset value by value.
datafold.bestWhen: you change SQL often and fear breaking data.
datafold.watchOut: it answers whether a code change altered data more than whether a table is healthy today, and no price is shown.

bigeye.name: Bigeye
bigeye.summary: A paid platform that has grown from data monitoring into AI trust, with lineage and sensitive data scanning.
bigeye.bestWhen: you are a large company linking data checks to AI use and will go through a demo.
bigeye.watchOut: no price or free plan is shown, and the AI focus may be more than you need for plain table alerts.
